meta.title: Aksara Pro - Khmer Word Processor with Smart Word Breaking & Spell Check
meta.description: The only Khmer text editor with intelligent word segmentation powered by beam search. 77,000+ word dictionary, voice-to-text, grammar standardization, and LibreOffice ODT export.
meta.tagline: Khmer Word Processor with Intelligent Word Segmentation

hero.headline: The Khmer Word Processor That Understands Your Language
hero.subheadline: Write with confidence using intelligent word segmentation, instant spell checking, and voice input. Export perfect documents to LibreOffice with proper Khmer line breaks.

features.headline: Built for Khmer, From the Ground Up
features.subheadline: Not a translation layer. A word processor engineered for Khmer's unique orthographic rules.

wordBreaking.title: Beam Search Word Segmentation
wordBreaking.description: Our algorithm analyzes 50,000+ words to find optimal break points. Respects COENG rules, protects compound words, and never breaks incorrectly.

spellCheck.title: 77,000+ Word Spell Checker
spellCheck.description: SymSpell algorithm delivers suggestions in under 200ms. Handles Khmer punctuation correctly and learns your vocabulary over time.

voiceInput.title: Voice Input with Smart Transforms
voiceInput.description: Dictate naturally in Khmer. Automatic conversion of number words to numerals and voice commands to punctuation marks.

grammarCheck.title: Grammar Standardization
grammarCheck.description: Detects non-standard spellings and suggests official forms. Keeps your writing consistent with accepted orthography.

odtExport.title: Perfect LibreOffice Export
odtExport.description: ODT files with Khmer Mondulkiri font configuration that actually works. Preserves word breaks for proper text rendering.

personalDictionary.title: Personal Dictionary
personalDictionary.description: Teach Aksara your vocabulary. Force words to join or split, add custom spellings, and sync across all your devices.

howItWorks.headline: Start Writing in Seconds
howItWorks.subheadline: No installation. No plugins. Just open your browser and write.

step1.title: Type or Speak
step1.description: Write Khmer text directly or dictate using voice input with automatic punctuation.

step2.title: Auto Word Segmentation
step2.description: Aksara inserts invisible word boundaries so text wraps correctly in any application.

step3.title: Export & Share
step3.description: Download as ODT for LibreOffice or copy text with word breaks preserved.

cta.headline: Stop Fighting Your Word Processor
cta.subheadline: Aksara Pro handles word breaks, spell checking, and formatting so you can focus on what matters: your writing.

dictionary.title: My Dictionary
dictionary.description: Custom words that will be recognized by the Khmer word breaker
dictionary.info: Your personal dictionary contains words that the word breaker will keep together. Words are automatically added when you use "Join selected words" in the editor. You can also add words manually here.
dictionary.emptyState: No dictionary words yet. Use "Join selected words" in the editor or add words manually here.

ignoredWords.title: Ignored Dictionary Words
ignoredWords.description: Compound words that should be split into their component parts
ignoredWords.info: Ignored words are excluded from word breaking. When a compound word is ignored, the word breaker will split it into its component parts. For example, ignoring "មានន័យថា" will cause it to split as "មាន ន័យ ថា". Words are automatically added when you use "Split word" in the editor, or you can add them manually here.
ignoredWords.wordPlaceholder: Enter a compound word to ignore (e.g., មានន័យថា)
ignoredWords.wordHint: This word will be split into its component parts when you type it in the editor.
ignoredWords.emptyState: No ignored words yet. Use "Split word" in the editor or add words manually here.

spellCheckWords.title: Spell Check Custom Words
spellCheckWords.description: Words you've added to your personal spell check dictionary or chosen to ignore
spellCheckWords.info: Manage your personal spell check dictionary. Added words are treated as correct spellings. Ignored words are skipped during spell checking. Words are automatically added when you right-click a misspelled word in the editor and choose "Add to dictionary" or "Ignore".
spellCheckWords.addedDescription: These words are treated as correct by the spell checker
spellCheckWords.ignoredDescription: These words are skipped during spell checking
spellCheckWords.wordTreatedCorrect: This word will be treated as correctly spelled
spellCheckWords.wordSkipped: Spell checking will be skipped for this word
spellCheckWords.addedEmpty: No added words yet. Right-click a misspelled word in the editor and choose "Add to dictionary", or add words manually here.
spellCheckWords.ignoredEmpty: No ignored words yet. Right-click a misspelled word in the editor and choose "Ignore", or add words manually here.
spellCheckWords.loadError: Failed to load your spell check custom words

replacements.title: My Word Replacements
replacements.description: Add custom word replacements that will be applied when you use voice-to-text
replacements.info: Your personal replacements override the master replacements when there are duplicates. This allows you to customize word corrections for your own writing style.
replacements.notesPlaceholder: Add any notes about this replacement
replacements.emptyState: No personal replacements yet. Add one to customize word corrections for your writing.
